summary: Full-site WCAG 2.2 AA re-audit (axe-core 4.10.2, tags wcag2a/aa,wcag21a/aa,wcag22aa) on all 12 public routes at desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844, plus keyboard/focus/structure spot-checks and content verification of the revised Privacy + Cookie policies. Initial scan found 1 violation (scrollable-region-focusable on mobile /insights/reactive-vs-preventive-maintenance) — the article-table wrapper (overflow-x-auto div) had no keyboard access. Fixed by adding tabIndex=0 + role='region' + aria-label to the wrapper in ArticlePage.jsx. Re-scan: 0 violations everywhere (24 route*viewport combos). All Privacy and Cookie wording assertions pass. All keyboard/focus/reduced-motion/iframe-title/sim-banner spot-checks pass. No forbidden terms on any of the 12 routes.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: /app/frontend/src/pages/ArticlePage.jsx table wrapper (block-type 'table') was overflow-x-auto without keyboard access. Added tabIndex={0} role='region' aria-label={block.caption || 'Data table'} so keyboard-only users can scroll horizontally. This was the sole axe violation this iteration (mobile only, because desktop had enough width). Consider using block.caption where present for a more descriptive region name.
context_for_next_testing_agent: axe-core 4.10.2 WCAG 2.2 AA = 0 violations on / , /services , /tmms , /demonstrations , /about , /insights , /insights/what-is-a-cmms , /insights/reactive-vs-preventive-maintenance , /contact , /privacy , /cookies , /tmms/demos/factory — at both 1440x900 and 390x844 (reduced_motion=no-preference, localStorage cleared, 1500ms settle). Privacy policy now cites legitimate interest (NOT consent), has voluntary+necessary note, exact 12-month retention sentence, England & Wales + Company No. 16567818 + info@nachieng.co.uk (no street address), Resend/US transfer with UK SCC Addendum + UK Extension to EU–U.S. DPF, full 8-point rights list incl. withdraw-consent-where-used + ICO, DRAFT banner present. No forbidden terms.
rca_of_the_issue: Single WCAG violation RCA: In ArticlePage.jsx the 'table' block type wraps <table> in <div className='my-10 overflow-x-auto'>. On mobile the table overflows horizontally, making the div a scrollable region. axe-core rule scrollable-region-focusable (WCAG 2.1 2.1.1 Keyboard) requires such regions to be reachable by keyboard. Fix: add tabIndex={0} role='region' aria-label to the wrapper. Verified 0 violations after fix.
